Delhi Air Quality Monitoring Network Expanded with New Stations

Delhi's air quality monitoring network has been expanded with the addition of 13 new air quality monitoring stations. The government has also introduced 150 electric buses to combat pollution. This initiative aims to enhance pollution surveillance in the city.
